k:床.mnemonic: A frame cut from a tree (木) and set up under a canopy (广): wooden boards to sleep on, with curtains overhead. Bed (floor, padding, tatami).

k:触.mnemonic: An insect (虫) holds its feelers out at an angle (角) and taps everything in front of it: a leaf, a twig, your fingertip. Contact (touch, feel, hit).

k:晴.mnemonic: The clouds part, and the day (日) turns blue (青) from one edge of the sky to the other. Time to hang out the washing. Clear up.
k:晴.hint: Sky turning blue edge to edge.

k:童.mnemonic: Small figures stand (立) at the edge of the hometown (里), waving as the travellers leave. They are too young to go, so they stay behind. Juvenile (child, kid).
k:童.hint: Small figures waving at the village edge.

k:迷.mnemonic: You marked the path (辶) with grains of rice (米), but the birds ate them, and now every direction in the forest looks the same. Astray (be perplexed, in doubt, lost).
k:迷.hint: Birds ate the trail of grains.

k:勇.mnemonic: A man (男) walks up to a snarling dog and slips a muzzle (マ) over its jaws with steady hands. Nobody else dared go near. Courage (bravery, heroism, cheer up).

k:隠.mnemonic: Behind the mound (阝) is the appropriate (当) place to duck down when the seeker starts counting. The children invariably (必) choose it. Hide (conceal, cover).

k:招.mnemonic: The swordsmith curls his fingers (扌) at you and calls with his mouth (口): come in, come and look at the new sword (刀). Beckon (invite, summon, engage).
k:招.hint: Swordsmith waving you into his shop.

k:誤.mnemonic: You mean to say (言) one thing, but your mouth (口) twists it on the way out and the wrong word falls from it. Too late to catch it. Mistake (err, do wrong, mislead).

k:謝.mnemonic: You shoot (射) an arrow through the neighbour's window. Then you walk over, bow low, and say (言) the words that have to be said. Apologize (thank, refuse).

k:幅.mnemonic: A long towel (巾) of silk painted with a rice field (田), unrolled down the wall. Each guest's mouth (口) drops open at how wide it is. Hanging scroll (width).
k:幅.hint: Painted silk unrolled down the wall.

k:納.mnemonic: The weaver carries her thread (糸) inside (内) the storehouse to hand over what she owes. Once the bundle is on the shelf, the debt is closed. Settlement (pay, supply, obtain).
k:納.hint: Thread handed over in the storehouse.

k:泣.mnemonic: Someone stands (立) alone with a tsunami (氵) of tears running down their face and puddles forming at their feet. Cry (weep, moan).
k:泣.hint: Standing in a puddle of tears.

k:届.mnemonic: The courier plants a flag (尸) at your door with a note explaining wherefore (由) he came: your parcel has arrived. Deliver (reach, arrive, report).

k:枝.mnemonic: The arm of a tree (木) that gives support (支) to the birds' nest and the child's swing. Branch (bough, twig, limb).
k:枝.hint: Tree arm holding nest and swing.

k:崩.mnemonic: Month (月) after month (月) of rain soaks into a mountain (山), until the slope gives way and slides down into the valley. Crumble (demolish, level, death).
k:崩.hint: Two months of rain, slope slides.

k:既.mnemonic: The stubborn (艮) old elephant shows the scar on his tusk (牙) and insists he has done all this before, long ago, and need not do it again. Previously (already, long ago).
k:既.hint: Old elephant has done it before.

k:竜.mnemonic: A crest standing up on the head, a body marked with scales in the middle, and a long tail that sweeps out and curls up at the end. Dragon (imperial).
k:竜.hint: Crest, scales and a curling tail.

k:腹.mnemonic: You have (有) eaten all day (日) at the festival, and now you trudge (夂) home holding the heavy round middle of your body. Abdomen (belly, stomach).
k:腹.hint: Trudging home after a day's feasting.

k:滅.mnemonic: First the fire (火), then the tsunami (氵). What the flames left has become (成) mud and ash, and the town is wiped from the map. Destroy (ruin, overthrow, perish).
k:滅.hint: Flames, then the wave: nothing left.

k:躍.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) chased by a broom (ヨ) kicks off with its leg (足) and sails clean over the farmyard fence, feathers flying. Leap (dance, skip).

k:銃.mnemonic: The quartermaster allots (充) one piece of metal, gleaming like gold (金) in the lamplight, to each soldier: a barrel, a trigger and six rounds. Gun (arms).

k:奪.mnemonic: A big (大) man takes the measurement (寸) of your prize turkey (隹) with his hands, then tucks it under his arm and runs. Rob (take by force, snatch away, plunder).
k:奪.hint: Big man runs off with your turkey.

k:忘.mnemonic: A memory that is deceased (亡) in the heart (心). It was there once, and now nothing stirs when you reach for it. Forget.
k:忘.hint: A memory dead in the heart.

k:燃.mnemonic: Dry straw is the sort of thing (然) you keep well away from fire (火). One spark and the whole stack goes up. Burn (blaze, glow).

k:緊.mnemonic: A retainer (臣) holds a thread (糸) pulled taut between his hands, and his shoulders are taut also (又), waiting for the lord's signal. Nothing moves. Tense (solid, hard, tight).

k:微.mnemonic: On a stroll (彳) up the mountain (山) you strike (攵) the rock with your stick, and the thinnest crack appears, fine as a hair and almost too small to see. Delicate (minuteness, insignificance).

k:徴.mnemonic: The king (王) reads delicate (微) signs: a faint ring round the moon, birds flying low. From these small hints he knows what is coming. Indications (sign, omen, symptom).
k:徴.hint: King reading faint signs in the sky.

k:撮.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) on the shutter take (取) a slice of the day (日) and keep it: one click, and the moment is caught on paper. Snapshot (take pictures).
